title: Blue Dolphin Charters
specs: Two 65' deluxe catamarans with restrooms and top deck for 360° views
Two 24' rigid hull inflatable rafts for adventurous tours including sea caves
Tours see about 15 miles of the 17 mile NaPali Coast, turnaround at Kalalau Valley
All Other Tours – Age 2 and up
Pregnant women not allowed on any tours
Passengers consuming alcohol must be of legal age and have valid ID
Groups of 10 or more have 72 hour cancellation policy

blurb: Guests board large catamarans or rigid hull inflatable rafts to explore the NaPali Coast, South Shore, and Niihau Island. Activities include snorkeling, sightseeing, whale watching, and enjoying meals and drinks on board. Tours operate year-round, weather permitting, with safety and comfort prioritized.
extraNote: 24 hour cancellation policy for all tours; 72 hours for groups of 10 or more · Within 24 hours notice, reschedule fee charged, 7 days to select alternative date · Tours operate rain or shine; cancelled if unsafe conditions like thunder or lightning · No refund for motion sickness · All tours depart from Port Allen, southwest side of Kauai. · Year round
